summary: Iteration 3 tested end-to-end (backend + mobile UI 390x844). All 4 new features PASS. Backend: 57/57 pytest cases pass (43 regression + 14 new iteration-3). Frontend: 4/4 critical flows pass. FEATURE 1 Preis-Historie – POST /api/customer-prices with a different price writes a price_history row (oldPrice/newPrice/changedByName), same price NO row; GET /api/companies/{id}/price-history is admin+sales only (customer 403), sales cannot query other-company (c2 -> 403), returns newest-first. UI: /kunde/c1 Konditionen after price-save-p1 with new price shows history-0 card with '15,75 € → 15,60 €' and 'Sergio (Admin)'. FEATURE 2 Lieferdatum – PUT /orders/{id}/status 'Versendet' sets trackingNumber (format SSyymmdd+orderNo, e.g. SS26091301013), shippedAt, estimatedDelivery (now+2d). Setting Versendet again does NOT overwrite tracking (idempotent, code guarded by `not o.get('trackingNumber')`). UI: admin advances a Neu order 3 times → order-shipping-card renders with Sendungsnummer + Voraussichtliche Lieferung; customer logging into the same order sees the shipping card and NO advance-status button. FEATURE 3 Mehrere Positionen – POST /offers with multi-item array: all ok -> Freigegeben, one below salesFloor -> Freigabe nötig, one below absoluteFloor -> 400. UI: add-line-button stages positions, second product added, remove-line-1 removes staged line, add is blocked with 'Unter absoluter Preisgrenze' hint when price < absFloor, submit label reads 'Angebot erstellen (2)' and the created offer card (A-2026-0226) lists BOTH 'Gambilongo Espresso Bar · 20 kg · 16,90 €/kg' and 'Caffè Aiello Strong · 5 kg · 18,90 €/kg'. FEATURE 4 Rechnung bezahlen – PUT /invoices/{id}/pay is admin+sales (customer 403), missing 404, sets status Bezahlt + paidAt; dashboard.openInvoices drops by exactly the paid amount. UI: /kunde/c1 Rechnungen segment, pay-invoice-RE-2026-0921 button tap flips badge to 'Bezahlt' and hides the button. Regression: 3-role login, /products /companies /offers /orders /invoices /contracts /dashboard /analytics all 200; two rapid /offers get unique sequential IDs.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking; migrate shadow* -> boxShadow on RN 0.76+/Expo SDK 52+. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx (Card shadow styles) and any other component using shadowColor/Offset/Opacity/Radius.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:437-446 correctly guards trackingNumber generation with `not o.get('trackingNumber')` so repeated Versendet PUTs don't overwrite (verified). trackingNumber format 'SS'+yymmdd+orderNoSuffix is deterministic per order — good.

server.py:248-259 price_history only writes when old_price != body.price (verified). oldPrice may be None on first-ever price set — surfaces in UI as 'Neu: xx,xx €' (kunde/[id].tsx line 134) — good UX.
server.py:466-478 invoice pay endpoint does NOT check inv['status'] is currently open — paying an already-paid invoice silently updates paidAt again. Consider returning 409 if already Bezahlt, minor.
server.py:466 pay endpoint is exposed to sales as well (matches feature spec 'staff'). Good.
server.py still uses @app.on_event('startup') (line 736) — FastAPI deprecated in 0.109+. Migrate to lifespan handler when convenient.
kunde/[id].tsx PriceEditorRow (line 250) uses only successful onSuccess -> onSaved; error path shows no message. Minor.
angebote.tsx CreateOffer: adding a line does not verify the same product isn't already staged (duplicates allowed). Backend accepts duplicates, so functionally fine, but consider merging or blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 4 iteration-3 flows (multi-line offer create, invoice pay, price history display, order shipping card + role-gated advance-button)

rca_of_issue: No unresolved issues found. Initial appearance of 'history-0 not visible' during first UI pass was actually correct behaviour: an earlier test in the same session had already written price 15.75 for c1/p1, so re-saving 15.75 was a no-op (backend correctly skips history insert when oldPrice == newPrice). Re-running with a different value (15.60) surfaced the history card with '15,75 € → 15,60 €' and admin name.
